_____
v3.x \_____________________________________________________________________________


v3.8.3 (2026.10.02)
- Updated the Nextor kernel and related tools to version 3.0 beta 2, by Konamiman.

v3.8.2 (2026.09.02)
- Added the Nextor kernel version 3.0 beta 1, by Konamiman.
  For the time being, NEXTOR.SYS v2 remains the default version for SDCREATE;
  to use NEXTOR.SYS v3 and the new tools, manually overwrite the SD card's contents
  with the files from the 'N3XTOR.ZIP' package obtained by creating a new SD card.
- Updated the OCM-MegaSDHC driver to version 1.5 in the Nextor kernels.
- Updated some tools in the [make\sdcreate\utils\] folder.

v3.8.1 [2025.11.16]
- Updated the Nextor kernel to version 2.1.4, by Konamiman.

v3.8 [2025.06.29]
- New ++Logo Toolkit v1.0 for Windows, an application designed to make logo
  creation simple and efficient. It is located in the [make\toolkit\] folder.
- New C-BIOS v0.29b, a slightly improved version intended for MSX++ machines.
- Updated the Nextor kernel and related tools to version 2.1.3, by Konamiman.
- Updated all logos and respective ROM files, including bug fixes.
- Updated various scripts in alignment with the new content.

Note:
- Main utilities from OCM-EXTRA Pack v3.1 are already included in this package.


v3.7 [2024.01.13]
- Updated the "MSX++ official logo" to version 1.4, sources are included.


v3.6.1 [2023.12.04]
- Updated the Nextor kernel and related tools to version 2.1.2, by Konamiman.

v3.6 [2023.10.19]
- Restructuring of the contents of the [make\src\] folder and new additions.
- New [make\dev\] folder that includes some specific Z80 cross-assemblers.
- Updated SDBIOS processing with the new u2-SX logo v1.1 by Denjhang, the u2-SX
  machine is currently in the design phase.
- Updated 'bin2hex.exe' v1.03 in the [make\bin2hex\] folder.

Note:
- Main utilities from OCM-EXTRA Pack v3.0 are already included in this package.


v3.5 [2022.09.24]
- Overall improvement of SDBIOS processing and SD card creation scripts.
- As of this release, most of BIOS have been updated to support cartridges such as
  Franky that do not correctly implement expanded I/O.
- Updated the Nextor kernel to v2.1.1 (final release) and the ESP8266 Wi-Fi BIOS.
- The following changes have been made to the logos:
  "MSX3 unofficial logo" has been replaced by "MSX++ official logo",
  "MSX3+ logo by Ferrerico" has been replaced by "OCM generic unbound logo".

Note:
- Main utilities from OCM-EXTRA Pack v2.9 are already included in this package.


v3.4 [2022.03.24] and earlier versions.
- Previous history is not available.


_____
v1.x \_____________________________________________________________________________


v1.2 [2011.07.17]
- First release.


___________________________________________________________________________________
Enjoy!
